description: Every Trello feature, plus a local SQLite mirror, offline search, and cross-board analytics no other Trello tool has.

novel_features.name: Overdue Sweep
novel_features.description: Every past-due card across all your boards, ranked by lateness and owner.

novel_features.name: Workload Balance
novel_features.description: Open and due-soon card load per member across every board.

novel_features.name: Velocity
novel_features.description: Cards completed per week over the last N weeks, per board or member, with trend.

novel_features.name: Cycle Time
novel_features.description: How long cards take from started to done, with median and p90 per list or label.

novel_features.name: Bottleneck
novel_features.description: Which list is clogged now, by card count and how long cards have aged in place.

novel_features.name: Checklist Completion
novel_features.description: Real card-level progress from checkitem completion across boards.

novel_features.name: Blocked Scan
novel_features.description: Cards flagged blocked by label, checkitem text, or comment, and how long they've sat.

novel_features.name: Churn
novel_features.description: Cards that bounce backward between lists, revealing rework and unstable requirements.
